extracted.intended_audience: early-career investigators preparing PHS 398 Career Development (K-series) grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and responding with a PHS 398 Career Development (K-series) application package (including resubmission responses) that documents candidate background, career development plan, research strategy, mentoring, institutional commitment, human-subjects protections, and other required components.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an Introduction to Application (e.g., resubmission cover describing substantive changes made in response to Study Section comments and denoting revisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For resubmissions, explicitly state how reviewer concerns were addressed, denote revisions (e.g., vertical black lines in margins), and summarize substantive changes to Career Development Plan and Research Strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate Information and Goals for Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the candidate's background, career goals and objectives, and how the award will advance the candidate toward independence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include evidence of prior research experience, publications, teaching, and specific short-, intermediate-, and long-term goals (e.g., publish two first-author manuscripts per year, submit an R01 by year 3, achieve promotion to Associate Professor within 7 years).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide clear Specific Aims for the proposed research within the career development award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A standard Specific Aims page is required (referenced as M-11_PHS_Career_SpecificAims.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Present the Research Strategy describing methods, analytic approach, and planned analyses to accomplish the Specific Aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address concerns about novelty and methodological rigor; include primary methods and note alternative/secondary methods to be explored (e.g., spatial methods, agent-based models, regression discontinuity, methods to improve generalizability). Clarify statistical notation and model components (e.g., decomposition of random effects).

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report Publication List (for RENEWAL applications only)
rubrics_metrics.description: For renewal applications, provide a list of publications and progress since prior award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List newly published, provisionally accepted, and submitted manuscripts; highlight presentations at conferences and other dissemination activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe plans for training in responsible conduct of research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include the RCR training component (referenced as M-6_PHS_Career_Training_Resp_Conduct_Research.pdf) per PHS requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate's Plan to Provide Mentoring
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, describe how the candidate will mentor others during the award period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include scope and effort for mentoring activities and how mentoring furthers career development (documented in required form M-20_PHS_Career_Mentor_Statements_Letters.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Plans and Statements of Mentor and Co-Mentor(s)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide detailed mentor/co-mentor statements describing their roles in training and career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include mentor qualifications, planned frequency of meetings, specific mentoring activities, and biosketches (referenced as M-15 and M-20 forms).

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors, and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Include letters of support documenting collaborations, resource access, and contributions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply letters that substantiate resource access and collaborative roles (referenced as M-14_PHS_Career_SupportLtrs.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of Institutional Environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the institutional environment and how it will support the candidate's career development and research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail departmental, center, and institutional resources, available coursework, seminars, and access to collaborators (referenced as M-10_PHS_Career_Inst_Environment.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional Commitment to Candidate's Research Career Development
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide an institutional commitment statement describing protected time, resources, and support for the candidate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document the institution's commitment to the candidate's protected effort and career progression (M-21_PHS_Career_Inst_Commitment.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Protection of Human Subjects
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe protections for human subjects, including risks, safeguards, and justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include required human subjects protection documentation (M-7_PHS_Career_ProtectionOfHumanSubjects.pdf) and address inclusion of relevant populations in analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data Safety Monitoring Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Data Safety Monitoring Plan when applicable to protect participants and data integrity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify monitoring procedures, frequency, and responsible parties; include when interventions or data linkages pose risks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Women and Minorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Address inclusion (or justification for exclusion) of women and minority participants in research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIH inclusion policies and provide plans or analyses stratified by sex and race/ethnicity (M-8_PHS_Career_InclusionOfWomenAndMinorities.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of Children
rubrics_metrics.description: Address inclusion (or justification for exclusion) of children in the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow NIH policies and include justification if children are excluded (M-9_PHS_Career_InclusionOfChildren.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals
rubrics_metrics.description: If vertebrate animals are used, provide required descriptions and justifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide species, numbers, procedures, and welfare safeguards as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research
rubrics_metrics.description: If research involves select agents, include required documentation and compliance plans.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow regulations and include institutional approvals and biosafety measures (referenced as M-17_PHS_Career_SelectAgentResearch.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe consortium or contractual arrangements and roles of partner organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide letters of agreement, description of data-sharing and responsibilities in multi-institution collaborations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide plans for sharing data, model code, and other resources resulting from the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete the resource sharing documentation (M-18_PHS_Career_Resource_Sharing_Plan.pdf) and describe timelines and mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe authentication procedures for biological and chemical resources used in the research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address methods to verify identity and purity of cell lines, reagents, and other key resources (M-16_PHS_Career_Auth_KeyBioChem_Resources.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide appendix materials permitted by funding guidelines (e.g., biosketches, letters, relevant documentation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PHS guidance for permissible appendix materials (referenced as M-12_PHS_Career_Appendix.pdf).

rubrics_metrics.name: Stem Cell Line Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: If human embryonic stem cells are used, either reference a specific registry-registered stem cell line or check the box indicating one from the registry will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a specific line cannot be referenced at submission, check the box: 'Specific stem cell line cannot be referenced at this time. One from the registry will be used.' Include cell line identifier when available (e.g., 'Cell Line(s) (Example: 0004)').

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions and Patents Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether inventions or patents are associated with the application and whether they were previously reported.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Answer 'Inventions and Patents: Yes/No'. If 'Yes', answer 'Previously Reported: Yes/No' and provide details as required for reporting obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Investigator / Change of Institution Procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide documentation and forms for changes in project director/principal investigator or grantee institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include former and new PD/PI names, institution names, and required administrative approvals when requesting changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship Status Declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare candidate citizenship or immigration status (U.S. citizen/non-citizen national, permanent resident, temporary visa, or not residing in the U.S.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If on temporary visa and application for permanent residency is pending, indicate expected status by award start date as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responding to Reviewer Critiques on Resubmission
rubrics_metrics.description: On resubmission, address reviewer concerns point-by-point and revise documents accordingly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarify omissions (e.g., populations analyzed), explain methodological choices, add mentor or coursework details requested, and explicitly note where revisions were made in the submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Development Plan — Specific Coursework and Training Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify formal coursework and other training activities planned to develop skills relevant to the proposed research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List course titles (e.g., 'Introduction to Health Policy', 'Health Services Administration: Program and Policy Evaluation', 'Special Topics: Spatial Analysis', 'Health Economics'), indicate which are critical versus additional opportunities, and describe short courses, symposia, and conference attendance plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Development Plan — Mentoring Team Composition and Roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe a multidisciplinary mentoring team (primary mentor, co-mentor, internal and external advisory committees) with defined expertise aligned to candidate goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide mentor biosketches, rationale for each mentor, meeting schedules (e.g., weekly mentor meetings, bi-weekly co-mentor meetings, quarterly internal committee, semi-annual external committee), and specific mentoring tasks (methods training, career development, policy contacts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Development Plan — Protected Effort and Distribution of Effort
rubrics_metrics.description: Document candidate's percent effort devoted to research, coursework, mentoring, conferences, teaching, and service during the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a distribution of effort table by year (e.g., % effort for mentor/policy meetings, formal education, conferences, data analysis, manuscript submission, grant writing) and total percent effort for K-01 award and professional responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career Development Plan — Meetings and Group Participation
rubrics_metrics.description: Detail participation in research groups, methodology groups, data cores, and policy meetings, including frequency and goals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List meetings (e.g., weekly mentor meetings 60 minutes, bi-weekly co-mentor 60 minutes, weekly Epidemiology/Outcomes group, monthly Health Policy Methodology group, NA-ACCORD monthly teleconferences) and describe their objectives and expected time commitment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Methods — Inclusion of Comparator Populations and Generalizability
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe plans to include comparator populations (e.g., Canadian and Mexican populations) and analytic strategies to enhance inference and generalizability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain rationale for comparator groups (e.g., 'universal access' comparator), and how they will be used to strengthen causal inference about policy effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Methods — Use and Exploration of Multiple Analytic Approaches
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate willingness to explore multiple analytic approaches (primary and alternative methods) to address Aims and strengthen inference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List primary analytic approach and alternative methods to be explored (e.g., spatial methods, agent-based models, regression discontinuity, generalizability-improving methods), noting that alternatives may be secondary but will be evaluated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical Model Clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure statistical models are specified clearly, with correct notation and explicit description of random effects and error structures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Avoid ambiguous notation (e.g., remove unclear epsilon notation); specify decomposition of random error into intercept and slope random effects with distributional assumptions (e.g., b ~ N(0, σ^2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentor Qualifications and Local Expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Include mentors with appropriate qualifications and, where relevant, local mentors (e.g., local biostatistical mentor) to provide day-to-day guidance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document mentors' track records (NIH funding, mentoring experience), specify local mentors for practical support, and provide evidence of agreed mentoring (meeting schedules and letters).

rubrics_metrics.name: Dissemination and Policy Engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan for dissemination of findings to scientific and policy audiences including presentations, conferences, and meetings with policymakers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify targeted conferences (e.g., CROI, National Health Policy Conference, SMDM, SER), conference attendance limits (e.g., not more than 9 days/year), routine policy meetings (e.g., quarterly meetings with HRSA HIV/AIDS Bureau), and plans to produce visual displays for policy makers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Productivity Expectations and Transition Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: State concrete productivity targets (e.g., publication goals) and plans for transition to independent funding (e.g., converting to R01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide measurable milestones (e.g., two first-author manuscripts per year; submit an R01 by end of year 3) and describe how award activities will enable these outcomes.
